changes.title: Well healing
changes.text: Well HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness while cleansing and other well effects remain unchanged.

changes.title: Healing effects
changes.text: Potion and delayed healing ticks follow the run's Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Restorative sleep
changes.text: Sleep recovery follows Healing Effectiveness; zero healing cannot leave restorative sleep permanently locked.

changes.title: Natural regeneration
changes.text: Natural HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness without adding random rolls.

changes.title: Well-fed recovery
changes.text: Well-fed HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Healing fractions
changes.text: Fractional recovery survives saves without banking overhealing; starting health, maximum-health gains and revival remain unchanged.

changes.title: Meal talents
changes.text: Hearty Meal's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Challenge recovery
changes.text: Duelist Challenge's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Elemental Strike recovery
changes.text: Vampiric Elemental Strike's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Soul Siphon recovery
changes.text: Soul Siphon's player healing follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Dew recovery
changes.text: Immediate dew recovery follows Healing Effectiveness before the final HP cap; shielding stays separate.

changes.title: Metabolism recovery
changes.text: Metabolism's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness without changing its hunger cost.

changes.title: Chalice recovery
changes.text: Chalice regeneration follows Healing Effectiveness; prick damage is unchanged.

changes.title: Frozen carpaccio recovery
changes.text: Frozen carpaccio's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Pasty recovery
changes.text: Pasty healing and its displayed recovered HP follow Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Phantom meat recovery
changes.text: Phantom meat's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Supply ration recovery
changes.text: Supply ration's HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Aquatic recovery
changes.text: Aquatic rejuvenation follows Healing Effectiveness while retaining its existing recovery budget and random rolls.

changes.title: Escape recovery
changes.text: Escape crystal HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness; escape behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: Torn page recovery
changes.text: Torn page HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Cursed wand recovery
changes.text: Cursed-wand player HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness; other targets retain original healing.

changes.title: Transfusion recovery
changes.text: Transfusion player HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness while ally healing and shielding remain unchanged.

changes.title: Vampiric recovery
changes.text: Vampiric player HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness before the final HP cap.

changes.title: City recovery
changes.text: City full-recovery effects follow Healing Effectiveness.

changes.title: Sungrass recovery
changes.text: Sungrass player HP recovery follows Healing Effectiveness while retaining its healing budget.

changes.title: Healing Effectiveness
changes.text: Enabled the Healing Effectiveness slider with shared player-recovery calculations; other characters and shielding retain their existing behavior.

changes.title: Healing regressions
changes.text: Added seven checks for healing boundaries, all six classes, recovery sources, fractional saves, revival and zero-healing sleep safety.

changes.title: Narrow scoring notice capture
changes.text: Corrected the narrow-screen test's scroll target so its screenshot shows the scoring notice rather than the bottom sliders.

changes.title: Cleric lore curation
changes.text: Reduced the stored Cleric collection to 50 distinct entries while keeping the feature disabled for this alpha.

changes.title: Lore regressions
changes.text: Added count, uniqueness, trigger and history-preservation checks; updated content expectations for the approved 50-entry collection.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded healing verification, the complete lore curation and remaining alpha limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I enabled healing customization while protecting revival and preventing zero-healing sleep from locking a run. Damage attribution, equipment supply and permanent statistics integration remain unfinished; custom settings still do not change earned scores.
